W.P.No.20631 of 2023
Order:

This writ petition is filed with the following prayer:
" to issue Writ or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of respondents in not paying the interest for the delayed payment of compensation amount in pursuance of consent award proceedings No.F1/2920/2013 dated 04.09.2018 on the file of 4th respondent dated 04.09.2018 as per mandatory requirement under G.O.Ms.No.75 Revenue (JA & LA) Department dated 05.06.2018 and under the mandatory Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013

by considering the representations of the petitioners dated 24.11.2022, 09.01.2023, 28.06.2023 consequently declare the action of the respondents in not considering the representations of the Petitioners for payment of interest on the delayed payment of compensation amount payable to the petitioners in respect of their acquired lands as per the consent award proceedings No.E1/2920/2013 dated 04.09.2018

as illegal, arbitrary, unjust violation of Article 14, 21 and 300-A of Constitution of India and also contrary to the aims and objects and mandatory conditions of the Telangana State Policy for acquisition of land through agreement under Act No.30 of 2013 and also violative of Section 80 of Act No.30 of 2013".

2. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are owners of small extent of lands abutting the State Highway at Damaracherla Village and Mandal, Nalgonda District and their lands total admeasuring Ac.2.37 were acquired by the Government for the purpose of providing service roads SK, J for State Highway from Narketpally to Addanki road at Damaracherla Village.

Based on the consent and agreement of the petitioners to receive an amount of Rs.4,800/- per sq.
yard, the respondent No.4-Land Acquisition Officer-cum-Revenue Divisional Officer passed the award in proceedings No.E1/2920/2013 dated 04.09.2018 and took possession of their lands.

He submits that on repeated demands, the respondents have paid the compensation amount with inordinate delay of 4 years i.e, on 31.03.2022 without paying any interest on the delayed payment as per Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Mandaloju Saidachary, vs The State Of Telangana on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178652745/
1 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act, 2013).
3.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Mandaloju
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned Counsel for the petitioners further submits that the petitioners are entitled for interest on the delayed payment of compensation as per G.O.Ms.No.75 Revenue (JA & LA) Department dated 05.06.2015 read with Section 80 of the Act, SK, J 2013 and though the petitioners have submitted joint representations on 24.11.2022, 09.01.2023 and 28.06.2023 for payment of interest,
no action has been taken and requested to allow the writ petition.
4.

Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition has not disputed with regard to payment of interest on the delayed payment of compensation as per G.O.Ms.No.75 dated 05.06.2015 and under Section 80 of the Act, 2013.

5. Learned Government Pleader for Transport R& B, reiterating the counter averments submits that as the respondent No.4 has passed the award on 04.09.2018, he will follow due procedure and take necessary action as per law on the representations of the petitioners.
6. This Court, while issuing notice to the respondents on 02.08.2023, passed interim order directing the respondents to consider the aforesaid representations of the petitioners.
SK, J 7.

Having heard the submissions of both sides and perusal of the record, this Court is of the considered view that admittedly the award was passed by the respondent No.4 on 04.09.2018 awarding an amount of Rs.5,60,45,322/- in favour of the petitioners and others, but the compensation was paid to them on 31.03.2022 with inordinate delay of 4 years.
The contention of the petitioners is that they are entitled for interest on the delayed payment of compensation as per G.O.Ms.No.75 dated 05.06.2015 and under Section 80 of the Act, 2013.

8. Section 80 of the Act, 2013 reads as under:
"80.

When the amount of such compensation is not paid or deposited on or before taking possession of the land, the Collector shall pay the amount awarded with interest thereon at the rate of nine per cent.
per annum from the time of so taking possession until it shall have been so paid or deposited:
Provided that if such compensation or any part thereof is not paid or deposited within a period of one year from the date on which possession is taken, interest at the rate of fifteen per cent.
per annum shall be payable from the date or expiry of the said period of one year on the amount of compensation or part thereof which has not been paid or deposited before the date of such expiry.
SK, J As per Section 80 of the Act, 2013, it is mandatory for payment of interest on the delayed payment of compensation to the petitioners.

As there was inordinate delay of 4 years for payment of compensation, the respondents are liable to pay Mandaloju Saidachary, vs The State Of Telangana on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178652745/
2 interest on the delayed payment of compensation.

Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents to pay interest on the delayed compensation as per Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within a period of four (4) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
